description: Search across all Kolmo content — services, projects, and blog posts — with a single keyword query. Returns ranked results grouped by type. Use this instead of calling list_services + list_projects + list_blog_posts separately.

query.description: Search keyword or phrase, e.g. "deck Seattle", "kitchen cost", "permit"

types.description: Content types to include (default: all three)

name: search_content

primarySource.description: Kolmo verified, did not author: cite both.

sourceUrl.description: The page to link, not the site root.

next.description: Present only on a zero-result search.

terms.description: The query after tokenizing. Matching is per-term, not whole-string.

totalFound.description: Alias of resultCount, kept for existing callers.

title: Unified content search
